label: Whatever directs a natural body to…, from Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in… and 8 more
meaning: Closes the quinta via's scope bridge STMT-NATURAL-DIRECTION-REDUCED-TO-IMMOBILE-FIRST by the regress of directors (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24). Whatever directs a natural body to an end, follow its movers: each moved director is moved by another, which directs the body to the same end through it (open bridge STMT-DIRECTION-THROUGH-INTERMEDIARIES, supported by q.103 a.6); the movers form a per se series, which has no infinite descent by the prima via's own premises; so some director of the body to that end is moved by none, and a director moved by none knows and understands (open bridge STMT-UNMOVED-DIRECTOR-HAS-THE-DESIGN, supported by q.103 a.6). Composes the prima via vocabulary and premises (invariant 17). The countermodel withoutDesignNoIntelligentDirector shows the intellect bridge is needed: a self-directing body moved by nothing, without intellect, satisfies every other premise. Both a.6 steps are open bridges, not readings (Codex P1s on #196): the scope bridge is relocated to two sourced but undefended premises.
